verdict.rationale: DPMA is a patent office offering online search databases and e-filing services, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, the evidence covers only web portals (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister), DPMAdirekt filing software, and paper filing. Nothing mentions an API, OpenAPI document, or equivalent spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
